I am a PhD candidate at the [Department of Economics, University of Oslo](https://www.sv.uio.no/econ/english/). I work on fiscal policy, wage formation, and fertility, using Norwegian registry data. My advisor is Martin Blomhoff Holm, and I expect to complete my PhD in the autumn of 2027.
